description: (0.5.0) Consumer binding of the registry-assigned lineage_id (RFC-ACDP-0004 §2.1 'Bind the registry-assigned lineage and origin'; RFC-ACDP-0002 §4.2). For a first version (supersedes: null) the consumer MUST verify lineage_id against the RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.6 derivation from body.ctx_id — offline, one hash. For later versions it SHOULD verify where checkable and otherwise reports lineage_id as registry-asserted. Lives in the ret- family because the derivation arithmetic is already pinned by lin-001.

input.derivation: lineage_id = 'lin:sha256:' + hex(SHA-256(utf8(first-version ctx_id))) — vectors in lin-001

scenarios.name: B — v1 body whose lineage_id is the derivation of a different ctx_id

expected.behavior: Accepted, with lineage_id reported as registry-asserted (unbound).

scenarios.name: D — v2 body with a receipt that fails RFC-ACDP-0010 §8

expected.behavior: A failing receipt is treated as absent; same as C.
